description: The December 5 Sofia anti-government rally and march are physically documented, but no attendee estimate establishes 50 people at that gathering. The 150-day campaign marker is not turnout.
required_followup: Find contemporaneous crowd count for the December 5 assembly; retain campaign and event attendance as separate variables.

description: The national taxi protest was executed on December 15, but attendance at Sofia was reported as about ten vehicles (not persons); other municipal assemblies were announced without verified execution/counts. No participants may be pooled across cities or across time.
required_followup: Seek a contemporaneous count of people at the same time/location in Sofia or a clearly organized national simultaneous action; verify execution in other municipalities.

description: A Sofia municipal notice returned by search was opened and found to concern December 20, 2024, not 2020. It is excluded.
required_followup: None for the 2020 event; use contemporaneous 2020 reports.

description: Varna conductor protests on December 2/3 followed a November action, but no crowd size is stated and over 270 layoff notices describe affected employees, not attendees. The state-policy target versus employer-level grievance is unresolved. Restaurant workers’ December 1 report retrospectively describes a November 27 action, not a new December gathering.
required_followup: Resolve the November-owned conductor candidate with attendance and state-policy evidence; do not create a December owner from publication date alone.

description: The December 5 gathering is one physical event in the July-start anti-government campaign. January searches found further physical Sofia demonstrations (13 and 24 January), but they do not establish uninterrupted December occupation/action, December 5 ending, or event threshold.
required_followup: Continue only with permitted adjacent-month reports if a specific end/episode claim is material; do not infer no activity or uninterrupted continuity from gaps.

description: BNR Varna/horizont and BNT Varna exact opens returned tool timeouts; these are technical failures rather than source denials. BTA’s actual 429 remains a distinct rate-limit restriction in November. No exact failed target was retried.
required_followup: Use other currently permitted sources; preserve exact failed targets and do not retry or bypass.

description: December 15 taxi action shares participants/issues with late-November tariff/transport actions but follows a break and a separate, completed two-day public sequence. Evidence does not resolve renewed episode versus new episode.
required_followup: Reviewer should compare November and December records; retain both date-specific gatherings and do not merge automatically.

description: Nineteen logged queries included four Bulgarian weekly windows, generic English/Bulgarian discovery, Sofia and regional leads, taxi/transport/conductors and adjacent January anti-government continuity searches. Rendered headers may be shared across combined queries and total result counts/clocks were not natively exposed. No LexisNexis-equivalent archive was searched.
required_followup: Bounded review can identify material feasible local or sectoral follow-up; do not claim exhaustive coverage or that no other protests occurred.
